slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_fuel_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total fuel cost of the production plan?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to minimize total fuel cost, directly matching the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P0 hidden slot was resolved in turn 1, but the agent continued with repeated questions about cost structure (turns 6,7,12) and time structure (turns 9,10,13), which qualifies as over-questioning.

summary: The agent correctly identified the objective (H1) but then asked many redundant questions after the key hidden slot was resolved, leading to over-questioning before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
